description: Application Administrator - can add credentials to ANY application/service principal in the tenant.

telemetry.detail: Entra ID audit log: 'Add service principal credentials / Update application - Certificates and secrets management' (directory logging is default-on).
Unusual addition of credentials to an OAuth app (built-in AAD/MDCA detection).

prerequisite_privilege: Application Administrator or Cloud Application Administrator role
abuse_primitive: Add a client secret/certificate to a privileged app registration, then authenticate as that app.
notes: Credential-add is audited and has a high-fidelity MDCA detection, but is quiet in tenants without MDCA/Sentinel. BloodHound emits this edge as AZAppAdmin (was incorrectly AZApplicationAdmin in the corpus).
